# Ruslan Drozdov (Руслан Дроздов)

> Personal site of Ruslan Drozdov (Ukrainian: Руслан Дроздов, nickname: drozdorus), a Ukrainian entrepreneur and investor. Founder of Calma, a performance lead generation agency for insurance, home services, and finance verticals in the US. Partner at the Ukrainian venture fund Adventures Lab.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://drozdorus.com/): bio, current roles, portfolio, portfolio news, media and publications
- [Українська версія](https://drozdorus.com/ua/): the same content in Ukrainian

## Current roles

- Founder, Calma (2024–now): performance marketing and lead generation agency, https://calma.io/
- Partner, Adventures Lab (2019–now): Ukrainian venture capital fund, https://adventureslab.vc/

## Career facts

- 2013: started in online marketing
- 2014–2018: Everad, an international affiliate network, grew as a manager and marketer
- 2018: founded Traffinad, a media-buying agency
- 2019–now: partner at Adventures Lab
- 2022–2024: venture partner at CLUST, venture builder
- 2022–2026: partner at Astroid, web3 venture studio
- 2024–now: founder of Calma
- Continues to support earlier portfolio companies as an advisor, board member, or strategic partner

## Portfolio

- Web2: YOPE (https://yope.app/), Reface (https://reface.ai/), OneNotary (https://onenotary.com/), DeckRobot (https://www.deckrobot.com/), Pibox (https://pibox.com/); Narrative BI (closed)
- Web3: Utexo (https://utexo.com/), Open Delta (https://www.opendelta.com/); ThunderStack (acquired), LTV Protocol (acquired), Stroom (closed)
